'''Gueye Arabah''' is a [[Seanchan]] lieutenant under the command of [[Tylee Khirgan]].

== Activities ==
During the final preparations before the [[Battle of Malden]], he reports to [[Perrin Aybara]] about two bands of [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] closing in very quickly.
